density_method.metric: pooled fractional token share / pooled original bp share across all windows
density_method.token_assignment: fraction of token span overlapping each region
density_method.absent_region: contributes zero regional bp/tokens to pooled totals

plot_merge.weighting: equal weight per source checkpoint, after pooling windows
plot_merge.provenance: source_count and source_provenance retained in the merged table; per-run tables unchanged

density_method.inference: existing forward outputs; no reverse-complement averaging
density_method.table9_relation: same fractional allocation; pooled cohort statistic rather than Table 9 per-window mean; different cohort and inference protocol

overlap_rule: At step 3000, lower density values and training bases are the equal-weight mean of both sources; upper illustrative routing uses the real published checkpoint. Discrete routing boundaries are never averaged.
animation: Ten measured checkpoints at 600 ms each, followed by 6 seconds illustrating actual two-stage routing and token compaction at the unchanged final checkpoint. Token strip shown enlarged.
routing_display: One species at a time, selected with Human / Mouse controls; both stages use region-colored boundaries.
curve_method: Fit one PCHIP curve to all checkpoints in log10 training bases, then reveal its fixed prefix; dots are measured values.
bpt_definition: Input base count divided by retained latent-token count at each routing stage.
